elements.requirement: Section 17 applies where a former tenant is, as a result of an assignment, no longer a tenant under a new tenancy but has under an authorised guarantee agreement guaranteed the performance by their assignee of a tenant covenant of the tenancy under which any fixed charge is payable.
elements.quote: (in the case of a tenancy which is a new tenancy) he has under an authorised guarantee agreement guaranteed the performance by his assignee of a tenant covenant of the tenancy under which any fixed charge is payable

elements.requirement: Section 17 applies where a former tenant is, as a result of an assignment, no longer a tenant under any tenancy but remains bound by a tenant covenant under which any fixed charge is payable.
elements.quote: (in the case of any tenancy) he remains bound by such a covenant

elements.requirement: A former tenant is not liable under an authorised guarantee agreement or covenant to pay any amount in respect of any fixed charge payable under the covenant unless the landlord serves on them a compliant notice within six months beginning with the date when the charge becomes due.
elements.quote: The former tenant shall not be liable under that agreement or (as the case may be) the covenant to pay any amount in respect of any fixed charge payable under the covenant unless, within the period of six months beginning with the date when the charge becomes due, the landlord serves on the former tenant a notice

elements.requirement: A notice served on a former tenant under subsection (2) must inform the former tenant that the charge is now due and that the landlord intends to recover from them a specified amount in respect of the charge and, where payable, interest calculated on a specified basis.
elements.quote: informing him— (a) that the charge is now due; and (b) that in respect of the charge the landlord intends to recover from the former tenant such amount as is specified in the notice and (where payable) interest calculated on such basis as is so specified

elements.requirement: A guarantor who has agreed to guarantee the performance by a former tenant of a tenant covenant under which a fixed charge is payable is not liable under the guarantee agreement to pay any amount in respect of the charge unless the landlord serves on the guarantor a compliant notice within six months beginning with the date when the charge becomes due.
elements.quote: the guarantor shall not be liable under the agreement to pay any amount in respect of any fixed charge payable under the covenant unless, within the period of six months beginning with the date when the charge becomes due, the landlord serves on the guarantor a notice

elements.requirement: A notice served on a guarantor under subsection (3) must inform the guarantor that the charge is now due and that the landlord intends to recover from them a specified amount in respect of the charge and, where payable, interest calculated on a specified basis.
elements.quote: informing him— (a) that the charge is now due; and (b) that in respect of the charge the landlord intends to recover from the guarantor such amount as is specified in the notice and (where payable) interest calculated on such basis as is so specified

elements.requirement: Where a landlord has duly served a notice under subsection (2) or (3), the amount (exclusive of interest) that the former tenant or guarantor is liable to pay for the fixed charge cannot exceed the amount specified in that notice unless specific statutory conditions for a greater determination and further notice are met.
elements.quote: the amount (exclusive of interest) which the former tenant or (as the case may be) the guarantor is liable to pay in respect of the fixed charge in question shall not exceed the amount specified in the notice unless

elements.requirement: A former tenant or guarantor may be held liable for an amount exceeding the sum specified in the original notice if their liability in respect of the charge is subsequently determined to be for a greater amount, the original notice informed them of the possibility of such a determination, and the landlord serves a further notice intending to recover that greater amount (plus interest, where payable) within three months beginning with the date of the determination.
elements.quote: (a) his liability in respect of the charge is subsequently determined to be for a greater amount, (b) the notice informed him of the possibility that that liability would be so determined, and (c) within the period of three months beginning with the date of the determination, the landlord serves on him a further notice informing him that the landlord intends to recover that greater amount from him (plus interest, where payable)

elements.requirement: For the purposes of service under subsection (2) or (3), any fixed charge that became due before the date on which the Act comes into force must be treated as becoming due on that commencement date.
elements.quote: any fixed charge which has become due before the date on which this Act comes into force shall be treated as becoming due on that date

elements.requirement: Neither subsection (2) nor subsection (3) applies to a fixed charge that became due before the Act comes into force if the landlord instituted proceedings for the recovery from the former tenant of any amount in respect of it before that date.
elements.quote: neither of those subsections applies to any such charge if before that date proceedings have been instituted by the landlord for the recovery from the former tenant of any amount in respect of it

elements.requirement: In section 17, a 'fixed charge' in relation to a tenancy means rent, any service charge as defined by section 18 of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 (disregarding the words 'of a dwelling'), or any amount payable under a tenant covenant providing for payment of a liquidated sum if a covenant is breached.
elements.quote: “fixed charge”, in relation to a tenancy, means— rent,any service charge as defined by section 18 of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 (the words “of a dwelling” being disregarded for this purpose), andany amount payable under a tenant covenant of the tenancy providing for the payment of a liquidated sum in the event of a failure to comply with any such covenant

elements.requirement: In section 17, 'landlord' in relation to a fixed charge includes any person who has a right to enforce payment of the charge.
elements.quote: “landlord”, in relation to a fixed charge, includes any person who has a right to enforce payment of the charge
